outline:
本課程主要目的為讓本校大學部學生可於四年級時，預作留讀本校碩士班論文研究之準備。學生須事先擬定學習計畫，並由指導教授引導進行特定主題研究，以培養學生研究與自學能力。
The purpose of this course is to let NTUT senior undergraduate students to study the master's thesis before entering graduate school. Students must prepare a study plan and be guided by a professor to research specific topics to cultivate skill and self-learning ability.
